recent_posts.title: Increasing the Trust of Your AI Applications
recent_posts.summary: Building trustworthy enterprise AI requires addressing fragmented architectures, data silos, security risks, and governance challenges. A unified database platform consolidates operational data, vector search, caching, and agent memory in one system, reducing complexity and latency. Hosting AI models within a secure VPC environment keeps sensitive data controlled while automated data preparation streamlines RAG workflows. Agent catalogs enable traceability and governance by logging decision-making processes. This integrated approach provides the security, reliability, and explainability needed to move AI from experimentation to production at scale.

recent_posts.title: Smarter Search With Graph Queries on Document Data
recent_posts.summary: Couchbase introduces a native graph model that layers directly on top of its document store, allowing developers to query JSON data as a graph without data duplication or managing separate databases. The implementation extends SQL++ with CREATE GRAPH statements and MATCH clauses for pattern matching, rewriting graph queries into JOINs and recursive CTEs. This eliminates the traditional trade-off between document database flexibility and graph database relationship modeling, enabling use cases like fraud detection, recommendation engines, healthcare analytics, and supply chain tracking within a single platform.

recent_posts.title: Filtered ANN Search With Composite Vector Indexes
recent_posts.summary: Composite vector indexes combine vector similarity search with scalar filtering to enable efficient Filtered Approximate Nearest Neighbor (FANN) queries. Unlike traditional approaches that retrieve many vector-similar candidates before applying filters, composite indexes integrate scalar fields (like nutritional values) directly into the index structure, enabling early pruning and reducing wasted computation. Using a grocery recommendation system as an example, the post demonstrates how embeddings capture semantic meaning while scalar filters enforce constraints, allowing queries to find items that are both semantically similar and meet specific criteria. The implementation uses Couchbase's vector indexing with FAISS-based quantization methods, where vector fields are explicitly marked in the index definition alongside scalar fields for optimized ANN search.

recent_posts.title: CodeLab: Building a RAG Application With Couchbase Capella Model Services and LangChain
recent_posts.summary: A step-by-step guide to building a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system using Couchbase Capella AI Services and LangChain. The tutorial covers ingesting BBC News articles, generating vector embeddings with NVIDIA NeMo Retriever, storing and indexing vectors in Couchbase, performing semantic search, and generating answers using Mistral-7B LLM. The implementation demonstrates how to use Couchbase's unified platform for database storage, vectorization, and model inference through OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

recent_posts.title: Building a natural language to SQL++ UDF for Couchbase using LLMs
recent_posts.summary: A user-defined function (UDF) for Couchbase that converts natural language queries into SQL++ using LLMs. The UDF accepts plain English questions, uses schema inference to understand data structure, calls an LLM API (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) to generate SQL++ queries, and executes SELECT statements automatically while returning non-SELECT statements for manual verification. Implementation involves creating a JavaScript library with inferencer and nl2sql functions, uploading it via curl, and creating the NL2SQL() function that requires keyspaces, prompt, API key, model endpoint, and model name as parameters.

recent_posts.title: Semantic Search vs. Keyword Search: What’s the Difference?
recent_posts.summary: Semantic search understands the intent and contextual meaning behind queries using AI and NLP, analyzing relationships between concepts to deliver relevant results. Keyword search matches exact words or phrases against indexed documents, offering fast and precise lookups for known terms. Semantic search excels in user-facing applications like e-commerce and customer support where natural language is used, while keyword search is ideal for structured data queries, log analysis, and exact identifier lookups. Modern systems often combine both approaches in a hybrid model to balance contextual understanding with precision.

recent_posts.title: Enterprise AI: The Ecosystem Behind Couchbase AI Services
recent_posts.summary: Couchbase announces the general availability of Couchbase AI Services alongside a partner ecosystem designed to enable enterprise-grade agentic AI. The ecosystem includes NVIDIA for GPU-accelerated inference, Unstructured for document processing, Confluent for event-driven streaming agents, Arize for observability and evaluation, and K2view for synthetic data generation. The platform provides millisecond-level data retrieval, built-in vector search, semantic caching, and model hosting, with integrations to AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and popular frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex.

recent_posts.title: Capella AI Services: Build Enterprise-Grade Agents
recent_posts.summary: Couchbase announces Capella AI Services, a unified database platform for building production-ready agentic AI applications. The platform integrates data management, model deployment, vector search, and governance capabilities to address common challenges like data privacy, hallucinations, and architectural complexity. Key features include Model Service for secure LLM deployment with NVIDIA partnership, Data Processing Service for handling structured and unstructured data with built-in RAG pipelines, three types of vector indexing for different use cases, Agent Catalog for governance and traceability, and AI Functions for SQL-based AI operations. The platform aims to simplify moving AI applications from prototype to production by consolidating multiple tools into a single database platform.

recent_posts.title: Building Enterprise AI: The Ecosystem Behind Couchbase AI Services
recent_posts.summary: Couchbase AI Services has reached general availability with a partner ecosystem designed for enterprise-grade agentic AI. The platform combines vector search, semantic caching, and model hosting with integrations from NVIDIA (NIM microservices for inference), Unstructured (document processing), Confluent (event-driven streaming agents), Arize (observability and evaluation), and K2view (synthetic data generation). The ecosystem addresses key enterprise requirements including data security, real-time processing, governance, and compliance while supporting popular frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and cloud platforms like AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI.

recent_posts.title: Building Multi-Agent AI Workflows with Couchbase Capella AI Services
recent_posts.summary: Learn to build a multi-agent AI system using Couchbase Capella AI Services and CrewAI. The tutorial demonstrates creating a Seinfeld script generator where specialized AI agents collaborate using RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) with vector search. Covers setting up Couchbase Capella cluster, deploying embedding and LLM models, vectorizing dialogue data, creating hyperscale vector indexes, and orchestrating multiple agents (Theme Analyzer, Plot Architect, Character Voice Expert, Dialogue Writer, Quality Reviewer) that work together to generate authentic TV scripts by retrieving relevant context from stored dialogues.
